We are a small family-run operation, not a warehouse or large packing facility. Every item is removed, transported, and packaged by hand. Shipping antiques nationwide is costly and labor-intensive, but we work to keep expenses as reasonable as possible. We combine items purchased within the same sale whenever we can. Handling fee is assessed for total purchase, not per lot.
ROUGH EXPECTATIONS FOR PACKAGING AND MATERIAL COSTS:
$6.50 – $10.50 | Tiny Boxes
6x4x4 boxes that can hold jewelry or very small items. Often not too fragile.
$8.99 – $16.99 | Small Boxes
6x6x6 or 9x6x6 boxes for small items and some small fragile items. The more fragile the item, the higher the handling cost.
$10.99 – $20.99 | Semi-Small Boxes
12x9x9, 12x6x6, or 12x12x12 boxes. Ideal for desktop ornaments or several small fragile items. More fragile or complex shipments require additional packing time and materials.
$12.99 – $25.99 | Medium Boxes
16x12x8, 14x14x14, or 18x16x9 boxes. Used for multiple small items grouped together to reduce shipping costs. Requires additional cushioning and void fill.

Large furniture, oversized artwork, and other shipments requiring extensive packing materials, custom crating, or freight preparation.
